headline: Missouri S&T stand alone on two wins
dek: Missouri S&T have won both their matches, scoring seven and conceding once, and no other programme has yet won twice. Five different players have scored those seven goals, three of them by Mike Banasik.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The chart's height is a single afternoon: Southwest Baptist have played once, and the eight they scored at Sterling are more than Truman, Illinois Springfield, Indianapolis, McKendree, Missouri-St. Louis, Upper Iowa and William Jewell have managed between them.

wire.line: Southwest Baptist have played once, scored eight and conceded none.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Seven matches are score gaps, finals with no published score, and all seven are dated before the earliest match that has one.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches are past their date with no result published, all on the same day: Missouri S&T at Kentucky Wesleyan, Southwest Baptist at Evangel and Truman at home to Hannibal-LaGrange. Missouri S&T's unbeaten record and Southwest Baptist's clean sheet are both waiting on a result.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Indianapolis have won one and drawn one without conceding; Rick Lammerts has made seven saves and has yet to be beaten.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Upper Iowa have drawn both their matches, scoring once and conceding once, and play in the conference's opening match, away at Missouri S&T.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Illinois Springfield have lost both matches and conceded six, more than any other programme; Kevin Kardel has made ten saves behind them.

last_match.line: Lewis had not scored in their opener against Purdue Northwest; at Parkside each goal came from a different scorer.

next_match.line: Rogers State have already beaten McKendree and Maryville; Rockhurst have conceded more than they have scored.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
